note: Written after the full replay finished and before any result was read. Three frozen files were edited while the replay ran, none of them able to change a forecast or a decision: (1) adaptation_model.signature mapped a missing batch difference to None instead of False, so the zero-difference signature was never found and adaptation_cases / valid_when / failed_when in the replay's snapshot files carry declared-prior costs; the cost at zero difference is 0.0 under both versions, so world forecasts (which only ever price zero-difference transfers) are identical; (2) case_schema.DECISION_STATUSES gained the second family's decision words, an additive change; (3) world.CaseMemoryWorld gained add_query_compound, a new method used only by system.py. The replay processes had already imported the old modules. The published case libraries are rebuilt with the corrected code.
